items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: And George Gano on the banjo. That was all of us.

ctx.x: And I stayed there several years. Oh, who all was in the hummingbird? Guy Kelly?

You said? I had Guy Kelly on the trumpet.
